title: Design System: Guía de estudio y práctica 2026 · Lecciones de moto

display.purpose: Title over the 3D field (lesson title, topic name, completion line), with white halo.

headline.purpose: Panel heading with red bar (Temas, Repaso); bike name in bottom bar.

title.purpose: Topic names on cards, lesson title in the top bar.

label.purpose: Spec-row labels, buttons, lesson buttons, status.

credit.purpose: Unofficial-project note and CC BY 4.0 model credit in the bottom bar.

shadows.name: marker-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts numbered markers off the bike.

shadows.name: title-halo
shadows.purpose: White glow keeping the title legible over the bike.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Marker scale (0.4s), button press, card reveal (0.45s), progress fill (0.7s).

motion.name: state-fade
motion.purpose: Background and border colour changes on cards, markers and buttons.

motion.name: camera-travel
motion.purpose: Camera moves between computed per-topic views; yields to the user on drag; jumps when reduced motion is set.

motion.name: control-gesture
motion.value: sine at 2.4 rad/s on the control's pivot
motion.purpose: The five rider controls perform their gesture while active; static pose when reduced motion is set.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The red next action in the bottom bar (Empezar, Siguiente, Terminar, Ir a la lección 2, Volver al inicio).
components.css: .ds-btn-go { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 28px; border: 1px solid #cc0000; border-radius: 8px; background: #cc0000; color: #fff; font: 600 1rem 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-btn-go:hover { background: #a80000; border-color: #a80000; } .ds-btn-go:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-go:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1d1d1d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The back action beside the primary (Anterior, Repasar desde el primero).
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 28px; border: 1px solid #1d1d1d; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #1d1d1d; font: 600 1rem 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #f4f4f4; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1d1d1d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Lesson Tabs and Top Bar
components.description: White bar with the open lesson as a red parallelogram tab, other lessons as plain soft-ink buttons that turn red on hover, then title and status.
components.html: Conoce la motocicletaTema 2 de 8
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 24px; height: 60px; padding-right: 32px; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #cc0000; font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-lessons { display: flex; align-items: stretch; } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 36px 0 32px; border: 0; background: #cc0000; color: #fff; font: 700 1rem 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: default; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 20px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-link { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; background: none; color: #626262; font: 600 1rem 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-link:hover { color: #cc0000; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1d1d1d; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-bar-name { align-self: center; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1d1d1d; } .ds-status { align-self: center; margin-left: auto; color: #626262; font-size: .9375rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Panel Heading
components.description: Section title with the short red bar beneath.
components.css: .ds-h2 { position: relative; margin: 0 0 22px; padding-bottom: 10px; font: 800 1.375rem/1.1 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1d1d1d; } .ds-h2::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 56px; height: 4px; background: #cc0000; }

components.name: Topic Card (active, with spec rows)
components.description: Grey card at rest, white with red border when active, opening into any number of label and text rows.
components.html:
Qué hace
Desconecta el motor de la rueda trasera.
El gesto
Aprieta y suelta con suavidad.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 340px; border: 2px solid #cc0000; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1d1d1d; } .ds-card-head { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2rem 1fr; column-gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 11px 16px; border: 0; background: none; text-align: left; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card-head:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1d1d1d; outline-offset: -5px; } .ds-num { grid-row: 1 / 3; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; color: #cc0000; } .ds-name { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-limb { font-size: .875rem; color: #626262; } .ds-body { margin: 0 16px 16px; border-top: 1px solid #e0e0e0; } .ds-row { padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e0e0e0; } .ds-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; padding-bottom: 0; } .ds-row dt { font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-row dd { margin: 2px 0 0; }

components.name: Seen Card
components.description: Grey card for a topic already seen: ink number and an ink check badge.
components.css: .ds-seen { width: 340px; border: 2px solid #f4f4f4; border-radius: 8px; background: #f4f4f4; font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1d1d1d; transition: background-color .25s, border-color .25s; } .ds-seen:hover { border-color: #bdbdbd; } .ds-seen-head { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2rem 1fr auto; column-gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 11px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: none; text-align: left; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seen-head:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1d1d1d; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-seen-num { grid-row: 1 / 3; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; color: #1d1d1d; } .ds-seen-name { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-seen-limb { grid-column: 2; font-size: .875rem; color: #626262; } .ds-seen-done { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1 / 3; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: #1d1d1d; color: #fff; }

components.name: Progress Stripe
components.description: One segment per topic of the open lesson (column count set by --n); segments fill red as topics are seen.
components.css: .ds-stripe { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 360px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--n, 5), 1fr); gap: 6px; } .ds-stripe li { height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #ebebeb; } .ds-stripe li.on { background: #cc0000; }

components.name: Marker with Caption Bar
components.description: Numbered marker on the bike; the active one is red and carries a dark part-name bar.
components.css: .ds-marker-wrap { position: relative; height: 40px; width: 220px; } .ds-marker { position: absolute; top: 5px; left: 0; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #cc0000; background: #cc0000; color: #fff; font: 700 .9375rem/1 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / .18); } .ds-marker:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1d1d1d; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tag { position: absolute; left: 40px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); padding: 5.6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgb(29 29 29 / .92); color: #fff; font: 700 .9375rem 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Bike Picker
components.description: Native select under a 'Moto' label at the top of the panel; options read Name · kind.
components.css: .ds-picker { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 340px; font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1d1d1d; } .ds-picker label { font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-picker select { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #bdbdbd; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #1d1d1d; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; } .ds-picker select:hover { border-color: #1d1d1d; } .ds-picker select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1d1d1d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Loading Pill
components.description: Small white pill over the 3D field while a bike's model loads; markers are hidden meanwhile.
components.css: .ds-loading { display: inline-block; margin: 0; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #626262; font: 600 1rem 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Model Block and Credit
components.description: Selected bike's name over the unofficial-project note and its CC BY credit (model title link, author, licence link), at the left of the bottom bar.

components.css: .ds-model { display: grid; min-width: 0; font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-model strong { font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; color: #1d1d1d; } .ds-model span { font-size: .8125rem; color: #626262; } .ds-model a { color: #626262; text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-model a:hover { color: #cc0000; } .ds-model a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1d1d1d; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The app reads as a motorbike product page: a white ground, one corporate red, grey cards that open into label-and-text spec rows, a bike selector at the head of the panel, and a fixed bottom bar carrying the chosen bike's name, its credit and the red action. The 3D bike sits in a light studio field rather than a dark viewer, so the page and the object share one daylight. The language (white, red, grey, Figtree, underlined headings, bottom bar) follows the structure and style of a commercial motorbike product page, but the product is an unofficial educational project and carries no third-party logo, wing mark, wordmark, photo, video, code or price (PRODUCT.md, Brand Commitments).

The visitor picks one of five bikes (Yamaha R1 2020 by default, a classic Vespa, a 125 cc naked, a Yamaha FZ 16, a Kawasaki Ninja 650) from a native list; the choice is mirrored in the URL as `?moto=id` and every lesson works on any of them. Only the R1 has separable controls that animate; on the others the controls topics carry an 'Ojo' notice row.

The content is a set of lessons held as data (currently "Conoce la motocicleta", 8 topics, and "Mandos y postura", 7 topics). Every lesson uses the same shell: three phases (intro, learn one topic at a time, a done review where any card or bike marker can be revisited), informational only, no quiz, score or exam. The shell must hold any number of topics and any number of rows per topic. Density is calm and tabular. Red is rationed to the places that mean "this is where you are or what you do next". The interface is white, grey and near-black ink; the bike is the only place with other colour, and that colour belongs to the downloaded model's own textures. Motion is camera travel between topics, the gesture of the five rider controls on the bike, one card reveal and the progress fill; nothing decorative.
keyCharacteristics: White page, grey cards, one red accent (#CC0000), near-black ink.
Figtree Variable throughout, heavy 800 for headings, 400 to 700 for reading.
A single 8px radius; the parallelogram tab is the only angled form.
Spec rows (label above text, hairline between) for every topic's sheet, in any number.
Lesson switching lives in the top bar: one red tab for the open lesson, plain soft-ink buttons for the others.
State is never colour alone: number, check, border, fill, scale.
Bike choice is one plain native select at the top of the panel, styled like the rest (hairline border, 8px radius), never a gallery or carousel.
The bike is a glTF model lit by code-made studio panels; the interface never recolours it except to tint the active topic's model parts red.

rules.name: The Red Means Here-or-Next Rule
rules.body: Red marks the current place (open-lesson tab, active card, active marker, filled progress), the next action (primary button), the hover on a lesson button, plus the heading underline. It is not used for decoration or body emphasis.

rules.name: The Highlight Stays in the Scene Rule
rules.body: Bike Highlight tints only the active topic's model nodes in the canvas. Interface elements use Corporate Red; do not use the highlight value in CSS, and do not tint any other bike part.

rules.name: The Weight Does the Work Rule
rules.body: Rank by weight and size inside Figtree; do not introduce a second family or letter-spaced uppercase labels.

rules.name: The Halo Keeps Text Legible Rule
rules.body: Text that sits over the 3D canvas gets a white glow (text-shadow: 0 0 0.5rem #fff, 0 0 1.25rem rgb(255 255 255 / 0.95)), never a dark or offset shadow. Text outside the canvas needs none.

rules.name: The Flat Cards Rule
rules.body: Cards and buttons carry no shadow; state is border and fill.

dos: Do keep the page white with card-grey (#f4f4f4) containers and ink (#1d1d1d) text.
Do spend red (#cc0000) only on the open-lesson tab, lesson-button hover, heading bar, active state, progress fill, link hover and the primary button.
Do use one 8px radius and Figtree Variable at weights 400 to 800.
Do present each topic as label-and-text rows under a short 3.5rem by 4px red bar beneath the panel heading, with as many rows as the topic has.
Do put part names on dark caption bars, and always pair state colour with a second cue (check, fill, scale, border).
Do keep the fixed bottom bar: bike name with credit line, one red segment per topic, secondary then primary button.
Do keep the chosen bike's credit with its licence link visible wherever the bottom bar shows the model block.
Do keep the bike choice a single native select at the top of the panel, mirrored in `?moto=id`, and hide markers while a model loads.
Do say honestly, in a plain 'Ojo' spec row, when a bike's model cannot show a control.
Do put a white halo behind any text laid over the canvas.
Do add lessons as data in the same shell: one tab or button per lesson, one card, segment and optional marker per topic.
Do light the bike with code-made studio panels on a light ground, and compute markers and camera views from the model.
Do keep education informational: revisit by tapping a card or marker, never by testing.
donts: Don't copy any third-party brand's logo, wing mark, wordmark, photos, video, 360 viewer, code or prices, or imply an official site.
Don't use a dark 3D viewer; the field stays a light studio.
Don't add a second accent colour to the interface chrome, or give inactive lesson buttons a fill or a red state at rest.
Don't recolour the bike beyond the active-topic tint, or hardcode a bike palette; the model's textures own its colour.
Don't add decorative motion beyond camera travel, the control gestures, the card reveal and the progress fill.
Don't add eyebrow kickers, glyph icons or a second type family.
Don't add quizzes, scores or graded feedback (user decision, 2026-11-12).
